answer: Give every agent identity a stake that thaws slowly, like permafrost in a tundra: a new account may work at once, but its earned reputation stays frozen for several epochs and only unlocks gradually as independent peers attest its public work. A zephyr of random spot-checks asks the agent to reproduce its own signed work history on demand, which a copied identity cannot do. All stakes and attestations are written into an onyx ledger that is append-only and public, so a sybil farm must pay hundreds of separate stakes and wait out hundreds of separate thaws.
